[id="verify-plugins-locally_{context}"]
= Verify plugins locally

[role="_abstract"]
Use the {product-very-short} 2.1 CLI to export a custom dynamic plugin and test it against a running {product-local-very-short} instance. The CLI stages new front-end system (NFS) assets for the local application without a `dist-scalprum` directory.

.Prerequisites
* Your plugin default-exports an NFS feature from a package entry point. A plugin generated by the 2.1 CLI uses its package root.
* You have a {product-local-very-short} checkout and Podman or Docker available.

The CLI manages its plugin entry in `configs/dynamic-plugins/rhdh-cli.generated.local.yaml`. Place any additional plugin configuration in `dynamic-plugins.override.yaml`.

.Procedure
. From the plugin project root, start {product-local-very-short} and stage the plugin:
+
[source,terminal,subs="+quotes"]
----
$ *npx @red-hat-developer-hub/cli@2.1.0 plugin dev start --configure --rhdh-local-dir _<rhdh_local_dir>_*
----
+
_<rhdh_local_dir>_ is the path to your {product-local-very-short} checkout.
+
The `--configure` option adds the CLI-managed plugin configuration include without replacing your existing user configuration. The CLI prints the application URL when the runtime is ready.
. Open the application URL and verify that the plugin's page or entity card is displayed. For an entity card, open a matching Catalog entity page.
. After editing the plugin source, re-export and restage it:
+
[source,terminal,subs="+quotes"]
----
$ *npx @red-hat-developer-hub/cli@2.1.0 plugin dev update*
----
. If the plugin does not load, check the installation logs:
+
[source,terminal,subs="+quotes"]
----
$ *npx @red-hat-developer-hub/cli@2.1.0 plugin dev logs --installer*
----
. Check the application logs:
+
[source,terminal,subs="+quotes"]
----
$ *npx @red-hat-developer-hub/cli@2.1.0 plugin dev logs*
----
. Stop the local runtime after testing:
+
[source,terminal,subs="+quotes"]
----
$ *npx @red-hat-developer-hub/cli@2.1.0 plugin dev stop*
----
